notes.title: Hero or Foe BETA is now OPEN for testing!
notes.content:
I understand when a new game starts with low exposure, open Beta testing would be the opportunity to gather feedback and attention by letting the public testing the game.

I know that this game is still in its early stage, and this game is set as a PVP multiplayer, which is why I want to ask for your understanding if you find trouble searching for a session or a match online.

Invite your friends to play together! It will be more fun!

If you like the game, please support me by purchasing the game from the Steam store.
